dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast white patch visible on the wing coverts, appearing as a singular bold geometric block rather than multiple narrow bands.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct transition; the dark grey-black of the crown continues uniformly into the mantle without a clear boundary line.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct orange-rufous patch located on the lower back/rump area, contrasting sharply against the surrounding slate-grey plumage.
